C
A projection is the two-dimensional representation of a three-dimensional object onto a flat surface, which is conceptually similar to casting a shadow.

B
This statement is the definition of a sphere. The fixed distance from the center to any point on the surface is called the radius.

C
This is the correct formula for the surface area of a sphere. Option A is the area of a circle, and Option D is the volume of a sphere.

B
The shadow cast by a sphere onto a flat surface is a circle. The radius of this circular shadow is equal to the radius of the sphere, r. The area of a circle is calculated using the formula A = πr².

C
The surface area of a sphere is given by the formula 4πr², while its projected shadow is a circle with an area of πr². Therefore, the sphere's surface area is exactly four times the area of its shadow.
